Suggest an idea

Want a new mod, or a change to one that's already there? Tell us about it. Your suggestion becomes a public issue on the Oinkster GitHub page, so other players can see it and add their thoughts.

Describe what it would do and how you'd use it in game.

Optional. The problem it solves, or when you'd want it.

Only if you're happy for it to appear on the public issue. Don't post your email.

Good suggestions

  • Stick to one idea per suggestion, so each can be tracked on its own.
  • Check the existing suggestions first. If yours is there, leave a 👍 on it instead.
  • Oinkster sticks to fair-play features, so ideas that give an unfair edge on servers won't be added.

Keep it clean

Suggestions with swearing or slurs are rejected, even when they're spelled with symbols.
